// Every declaration here is one identifier or one character away from a
// declaration in the fixture that breaks the rules, and every one of them is
// legal in every layer.
//
// This is the half that decides whether anybody can live with the two readers. A
// rule that refuses the route itself, the error path of every function in the
// floor, or a number written in a comment is a rule that gets switched off.

package calculation

// The route itself. The one place a container may be filled is the function the
// rule names, and reading this file as the floor leaves it silent.
func New(set BandSet, values []float64) (Spectrum, error) {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return Spectrum{}, errNothingToBuild
	}
	return Spectrum{set: set, values: values}, nil
}

// The octave container's route, which has a different name and is silent for the
// same reason.
func EnergySumToOctave(values []float64) (OctaveSpectrum, error) {
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return OctaveSpectrum{}, errNothingToBuild
	}
	return OctaveSpectrum{values: values}, nil
}

// An empty literal carries no values and is how every function in the floor
// returns a failure. A rule refusing this would refuse the error path of the
// whole layer.
func widened(s Spectrum) (Spectrum, error) {
	if s.set == 0 {
		return Spectrum{}, errNothingToBuild
	}
	return s, nil
}

// A type whose name begins with a container's name is not that container.
type SpectrumReader struct{ set BandSet }

func read() SpectrumReader { return SpectrumReader{set: Core} }

// A band centre with a name is the repair rather than the defect, and a const
// block is where it goes.
const (
	millimetresPerMetre = 1000
	referenceArea       = 500
)

// A const inside a function body is the same declaration and is read the same
// way.
func scaled(width int) int {
	const centresPerMetre = 100
	return width / centresPerMetre
}

// A centre inside a string is a string, and a centre in a comment is a comment:
// nothing here is about the 100 Hz band, about a certificate that stops at
// 3150 Hz, or about the 50 Hz band the extended set adds.
func describe() string { return "the 1000 Hz band" }

// Numbers that are not centres, in the sizes and counts a calculation carries.
func sizes() []int { return []int{16, 21, 64, 1024} }
